create_plugin_registry: create a PluginRegistry instance to register and look up plugin classes by name
register_plugin_class: register a plugin class with a given name in a PluginRegistry instance
use_register_as_decorator: use the register_as decorator to register a class under a specific name
get_registered_class: get a registered plugin class by its name from a PluginRegistry instance
make_url_plugin_instance: create a plugin instance from a URL using URLPluginRegistry make_instance method
